claim_boundary: This roadmap is engineering governance only. It is not clinical validation, not clinician sign-off, not emergency coverage, not proof of patient benefit, and not healthcare production readiness.

automation_controls.industry_reason: External channels fail; the system needs a local auditable queue before dispatch.
automation_controls.minimum_requirement: Every high-risk event creates a local alert row before any webhook/email/SMS/Viber attempt.

automation_controls.industry_reason: Webhook payloads should not leak raw chat text or patient identifiers.
automation_controls.minimum_requirement: Use redacted payloads, HMAC signatures, timestamp tolerance, and replay protection.

automation_controls.industry_reason: Retries must not create duplicate clinical-review tasks.
automation_controls.minimum_requirement: Stable event_id/idempotency_key across retries and dedupe checks in the receiver.

automation_controls.industry_reason: Operators need to see failed notification attempts and recover safely.
automation_controls.minimum_requirement: Bounded retries, dead-letter reason, manual requeue, and no loss of local alert.

automation_controls.industry_reason: Transport delivery is not the same as clinician review.
automation_controls.minimum_requirement: Separate delivery receipt, opened/reviewed, and manual acknowledgement states.

automation_controls.industry_reason: Without clinical operations ownership, real alerting can create false assurance.
automation_controls.minimum_requirement: Email/SMS/Viber/n8n are disabled by default and limited to synthetic test recipients.

xai_controls.industry_reason: Each patient-visible number needs meaning, calculation, uncertainty, and safe next step copy.
xai_controls.minimum_requirement: Expose a typed explanation envelope for every KPI/model/review-count surface.

xai_controls.industry_reason: Reviewers need to know model version, inputs, missingness handling, and synthetic-only limits.
xai_controls.minimum_requirement: Attach model-card and feature-dictionary links to each synthetic ML output.

xai_controls.industry_reason: Low evidence should reduce confidence or abstain, not produce more decisive language.
xai_controls.minimum_requirement: Show modalities present/missing, abstention reason, confidence source, and known weakness.

xai_controls.industry_reason: Feature importance can be mistaken as clinical causality.
xai_controls.minimum_requirement: Label contribution displays as non-causal synthetic engineering explanations.

xai_controls.industry_reason: RAG answers need visible evidence limits, especially when citation precision is weak.
xai_controls.minimum_requirement: Show answerability, citation support, source-tier policy, and unsupported-context warnings.

xai_controls.industry_reason: Credibility improves when failed experiments are not hidden.
xai_controls.minimum_requirement: Keep pruner regression, BM25 comparison, reranker non-proof, and held-out weaknesses visible.

ranked_backlog.item: Build an Automation Center admin card
ranked_backlog.why: Shows outbox state, test-recipient delivery receipts, retry/dead-letter status, and manual acknowledgement separately.
Turns every patient-visible number into meaning + calculation + uncertainty + allowed next action.
Makes synthetic ML outputs auditable without making them look clinically authoritative.

ranked_backlog.item: Run generated-answer A/B before any citation-window change
ranked_backlog.why: A smaller citation window may improve precision but could reduce answer support; live behavior should not change from retrieval-only metrics.

ranked_backlog.item: Create n8n inactive templates for escalation digest and dead-letter review
ranked_backlog.why: Industry-aligned automation can be demonstrated without enabling real patient alerting.

industry_alignment_summary: NLCare is closest to industry practice when automation is treated as an auditable local review workflow and XAI is treated as a typed explanation contract with uncertainty and known weaknesses visible.
what_is_still_not_industry_ready: No real clinical operations owner or on-call process.
No real PHI channel review or compliance sign-off.
No real patient data or clinical validation.
No live alerting beyond synthetic test-recipient scaffolding.
